stance_rationale: The draft can be treated as a non-binding scenario memo, but it is not approval-grade risk output: required WT artifacts, production covariance, walk-forward schedule, and several risk-prompt checklist items are absent. The weakest claims rely on ex-post post-2015 sleeve returns and missing crisis/regime evidence rather than a formal PIT alpha-to-risk lifecycle.

sigma_audit.method_selected: none selected; 16 sleeve-level scenario-estimator diagnostics only

regime_sigma_audit.comment: No formal regime-conditional Sigma exists; only COVID_2020 has crisis data, so CRISIS evidence is n=1 without bootstrap CI.

crowding_audit.family_saturation_check: PG2 active-book TDC/style correlation is not measured; reported scenario HHI is 0.52-0.66, above the 0.40 RF-R3 threshold.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: Cycle 6 uses one ex-post post-2015 sample rather than rolling/expanding walk-forward alpha_scores, universe, Sigma, and weights.
Scenario-level decay and trade-off metrics are computed and interpreted on the same 2015-2026 aggregate window.
The draft asserts inherited DD/VT lag but cycle6 code does not directly verify vol_lag or dd_lag.
External macro lag is not verified in cycle6; FRED/KR internals are declared out of scope.
No formal factor-return PIT calculation or BΩB'+D decomposition is produced.
Cycle6 reads inherited master_returns CSV directly; no load_month_factors() path or Factor DB access discipline is verified.

critical_concerns.description: The required verification artifacts are missing: both specified stage_artifacts directories, weights.csv, alpha_scores.parquet, and covariance.parquet are absent. That blocks the requested time-series schedule check and post-shrink Sigma PSD/condition verification.

This is not a Sigma decomposition package: no B matrix, Omega, D, factor coverage R2, shrinkage intensity, selected production estimator, selection objective, or covariance.parquet is provided. Sleeve-level covariance summaries are diagnostics, not BΩB'+D risk infrastructure.

The main scenario-level decay conclusion is driven by AR 70-80% dominance on one ex-post post-2015 sample. Treating that as decision-ready weakens the source-level P1 decay warning and bypasses the walk-forward alpha-risk-optimizer process.

AX-001 v2 fails materially: all four scenarios fail crisis_alpha and bad/normal correlation tests, while crisis_alpha is measured only on COVID_2020 with n=1 because GFC_2008 and EuDebt_2011 are missing.

Tail-risk coverage is incomplete: CVaR_95, CDaR_95, Hill alpha, VaR/ES confidence intervals, and proper EVT MLE diagnostics are absent. Reported ES99 is 9.5-11.1% monthly, far above the default 2.5% CVaR cap proxy threshold.

Crowding is not approval-grade: HHI is 0.52-0.66, Scenario B HHI is null despite single stochastic AR exposure, and no PG2 active-book TDC, style correlation, or L-219 family saturation test is provided.
PIT pass claims rely on scope exclusions or inheritance rather than direct cycle6 evidence. C9, C11, C12, and C15 should be treated as unverified failures for a formal risk package.

The package says 'decision information only' and 'formal lifecycle later' but also declares TERMINATE_BENEFICIAL_DECISION_READY. That is a No Silent Override risk because formal lifecycle defects are converted into closure language.

supporting_arguments: Reported sleeve-level covariance CSV rows are PSD and have condition numbers below 100, with max reported condition 55.7154.
The draft does disclose that alpha_scores.parquet, weights.csv, BΩB'+D, KRX VKOSPI, and post-shrink Sigma are outside this cycle.
The package explicitly reports all four scenarios as AX-001 v2 PASS_1_OF_3 rather than hiding Test 1 and Test 3 failures.
unresolved_disputes: Whether Cycle 6 is being judged as a formal risk_package or only a non-approvable meta-research memo.
Which production covariance estimator and shrinkage intensity should be used downstream.
Whether Q-Lead can use the trade-off matrix before the missing WT artifacts and 3-agent challenge context are produced.
How PG2 active-book crowding, style correlation, and family saturation will be measured.
weakest_assumption: The single weakest assumption is that ex-post post-2015 sleeve-return scenario diagnostics are sufficient decision input despite no walk-forward alpha_scores, no weights schedule, no production covariance.parquet, and only n=1 crisis_alpha evidence.
rebuttal_required: Provide the missing alpha_scores.parquet, weights.csv, covariance.parquet, and stage artifact directories or explicitly label the package non-approvable.
Produce formal BΩB'+D with selected estimator, shrinkage intensity, factor coverage R2, and condition-number objective.
Add CVaR_95, CDaR_95, Hill alpha, EVT MLE diagnostics, and bootstrap CI for crisis/tail estimates.
Measure PG2 active-book TDC, HHI, style correlation, and L-219-style family saturation.
Replace decision-ready termination language with a formal lifecycle blocker list.
